description: Kubernetes manifest security audit — Scan Kubernetes YAML (multi-document) for risky settings: privileged containers, hostNetwork/hostPID/hostIPC, runtime socket and hostPath mounts, privilege escalation, running as root, dangerous capabilities, :latest or untagged images, missing limits/requests/probes, auto-mounted service account tokens, missing seccomp, plaintext secrets in env, RBAC wildcards and escalation verbs, cluster-admin bindings, exposed Services. Pass text= or url=. Returns PASS/REVIEW/FAIL, score, resources and findings with fixes. Offline, line-based (Helm templates are not rendered). Price: $0.006 USDC (Base, via x402).

text.description:
kind: Pod
metadata:
  name: web
spec:
  containers:
    - name: app
      image: nginx
      securityContext:
        privileged: true

name: security_k8s_check
